items.title: Muggsy Spanier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: I liked Freddie very much. He didn't make many records.

ctx.x: Well, how was Freddie Kepler? Did you ever listen to him much? Oh, yes.
I liked Freddie very much. He didn't make many records.
No. And some people say they don't sound like he really played. I just wondered how did he compare with Oliver and Louie and the rest of the New Orleans fellas?

items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Freddie Kepler, well Freddie Kepler and Joe, yeah.

ctx.x: Oh yeah? Well let's, let's, well you know, we can all join in. Yeah. How did you first start, Rosie? Well I started on Clark Street, Chicago, just when I was a kid going to school. Are you a, are you a Chicagoan? Yes, I'm born and raised in Chicago. I didn't know the north side. Everyone thinks I was raised in the south side, but I wasn't. It'd be right up south side. I used to live on the south side and I had music, Joe Alvarez. Who were the first people you heard on the south side? Joe Alvarez. Joe Alvarez. No,…
You heard Sugar? No, no, no. Did you hear Sugar Johnny? No. Freddie Kepler. Freddie Kepler, well Freddie Kepler and Joe, yeah.
